reflection.title: Reflection

Sit with what you missed, then return to the Free Energy Architecture deep-dive. Dark Ages and Industrial Revolution are cover labels. Break the Perceived Knowledge wall around Tuning Forks, Radium, and Atmospheric Condensers — or the control matrix keeps selling coal slavery as progress.
